questions.passage: Then we can remind ourselves that Hilma af Klint created her amazing, abstract pieces before Piet Mondrian and Wassily Kandinsky, without any direct association with any major avant-garde artists. Unlike most artists, af Klint did not want the public to see her work until after her death.
questions.prompt: Which statement matches the account of af Klint?
options: She made abstract works before Mondrian and Kandinsky and wanted posthumous public display.
She developed abstract works only after direct collaboration with Kandinsky.
She wanted to display all her work publicly during her lifetime.
She refused any eventual public viewing of her work.
questions.promptZh: 哪项符合本段对af Klint的叙述？
optionsZh: 早于Mondrian和Kandinsky创作抽象作品，希望死后才公开。
仅在与Kandinsky直接合作后才创作抽象作品。
希望生前公开全部作品。
拒绝作品将来任何形式的公开。
analyses: A before给创作先后，until after her death给公开时间限制。
B without any direct association否定此处直接联系；不能说由Kandinsky带动。
C 把not...until after改成生前。
D 不愿生前展示不等于永不公开；也没说她与世上所有艺术家绝无任何联系。

evidence.quote: created her amazing, abstract pieces before Piet Mondrian and Wassily Kandinsky
af Klint did not want the public to see her work until after her death.

vocabulary.context: 指主要前卫艺术家，限定原文所说没有直接联系的对象

questions.translation: 然后，我们就能提醒自己：Hilma af Klint在Piet Mondrian和Wassily Kandinsky之前，已经创作了令人惊叹的抽象作品，而且与任何主要前卫艺术家都没有直接联系。与大多数艺术家不同，她不想让公众在自己去世前看到作品。
